name: @enhancely/adapter-lambda-edge
description: CloudFront Lambda@Edge adapters for the Enhancely JSON-LD injector: origin-request (generates the response, one origin hit) and origin-response (re-fetch pattern), both fail-open

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.js "--external:@aws-sdk/*" && esbuild src/origin-request.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/origin-request.js "--external:@aws-sdk/*"
scripts.package: pnpm run build && { cp connector-config.json dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; } && cd dist && rm -rf lambda.zip lambda-origin-request.zip .pkg && zip -q -X lambda.zip index.js && { zip -q lambda.zip connector-config.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; } && mkdir -p .pkg && cp origin-request.js .pkg/index.js && { cp connector-config.json .pkg/ 2>/dev/null || true; } && ( cd .pkg && zip -q -X ../lambda-origin-request.zip index.js && { zip -q ../lambda-origin-request.zip connector-config.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; } ) && rm -rf .pkg && echo 'dist/lambda.zip (origin-response) + dist/lambda-origin-request.zip (origin-request) ready'
